acceptance_criteria.description: Tests requiring AOSEBench, HarnessX, Terminal-Bench, or HCP source checkouts are hermetic or explicitly classified when those pinned sources are unavailable
Tests and boundary audits do not assume one workstation Python, echo binary, or ripgrep installation
The content-addressed existing CI workflow remains byte-identical
MagentaBench required gate and Execution profile required gate both pass on the clean GitHub runner

objective: Remove hidden workstation assumptions from required tests so a clean GitHub runner verifies portable core behavior while external checkout tests skip explicitly or use hermetic fixtures.
title: Make required CI hermetic across clean runners
